answer: Pay rewards as transferable claims maturing after a voyage of several epochs, and let anyone trade them. An honest agent with real clients waits and collects par. A sybil funds k identities up front and must recycle capital, so it dumps all k claims early. Released together, they echo in the order book; each seller cuts the price for its siblings. The discount deepens with k while the work stays worth one honest agent's. Outside buyers see correlated issuance and price it as one risk. This ridge between patience and refinancing hunger makes cloning self-defeating, with no fingerprinting.
